name: RESAMPLE: a track, the main mix or USB recorded and saved as a sample, on a page of its own (SETTINGS + RECORD)
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (notes/79): built once into resample.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build when its card is ticked (compose.py --resample), with or without packages. The audio function's call of the mixer (0x40059872, jsr 0x400567ba) goes to the part's rs_mix: idle it jumps to the mixer; armed or recording it hands the chosen source to the recorder, a track's buffer before the mixer (after Volume + Dist and the Track FX, before level, pan and the sends), the main bus or the USB input after it. A take starts on the source's trigger (TRIG), its level (LEVEL, with the eight blocks before it) or at once (NOW), is kept in 32 bits in the RAM claim, and ends on RECORD, at its length or after 250 ms of silence, the tail cut. Since 0.2 (step R2) SETTINGS + RECORD opens the RESAMPLE page (TransportView's toggle of GRID RECORDING, 0x40024482): eight knobs set the take, RECORD arms, cancels or ends it, RETURN or SETTINGS + RECORD closes the page, every other key goes on to the views below (Trig Preview plays under it). SETTINGS is held when isKeyHeld(13) says so or its events do: the key event's code accessor (0x4007240c) goes to the part's rs_code, as Model-TG's key_hook takes it. Since 0.3 (step R3) a finished take is named in the stock name editor and saved to /recordings/<name> by the stock FileWriter in the UI task, a piece a message (save.c, Model-TG's way), with NORM or as heard; the page closes and the OS's popup says where it went. Armed for TRIG, the page turns GRID RECORDING on for Trig Preview and back off after. Since 0.4 (step R3b) TO Tn puts the saved file on the selected track's SAMPLE sound, and a track's full scale is SAMPLE's in the track's buffer (2^30 out of its interpolator, doubled by the OS's 2:1 decimator, a quarter after PUNCH, halved by the voice loop: 2^28, shift 3), so that a take of a track replays on SAMPLE as it was heard.

gestures.meaning: opens the RESAMPLE page (RECORD on it arms, RETURN or SETTINGS + RECORD closes it)
gestures.replaces: the toggle of GRID RECORDING while SETTINGS is held (notes/79 §1)
